profile.headline: Software Engineer / Communications background | Web Development | HTML | CSS | Javascript |
profile.summary:
Front-End Developer | Dedicated to Creating Engaging Web Experiences

I'm an entry-level front-end developer with a genuine interest for crafting websites that capture users' 
attention and spark excitement about the possibilities of web development. I believe that great code 
should not only function flawlessly but also create meaningful connections between users and digital experiences.

With a background in communication, I bring strong collaboration skills and a user-focused perspective 
to every project. I understand that the best websites are built when technical expertise meets clear communication and creative vision.

What drives me:

•Building responsive, user-friendly interfaces that make a lasting impression 

•Collaborating with teams to bring creative ideas to life

•Staying current with emerging web technologies and design trends

•Creating code that's both functional and beautiful

When I'm not coding, you'll find me courtside watching tennis matches or sketching in my notebook
both activities that fuel my appreciation for precision, strategy, and creative expression.
I'm excited to connect with fellow developers, designers, and anyone passionate about the ever evolving
world of web development. Let's build something amazing together!

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description:
Meme Generator - developed a website using HTML, CSS, and Javascript that allows users to input text that will output a relevant meme
Jeopardy - Used HTML, CSS and Javascript. App based on the television show

positions.title: Associate Producer
positions.description: Facilitating getting show props for producers, teleprompter for correspondents during live and pre-shows. Oversaw video clip editing of integrated digital content, preparing, and cataloging them for digital platform uploads with 100% accuracy.

positions.title: Library Researcher
positions.description: Logging and labeling tapes for producers and archival purposes. Pulled necessary clips of specific events/people from footage library, in aid of producers, and production assistants.

positions.title: Senior Production Assistant
positions.description: Production Assistant for Bravo Fashion Queens, worked closely with the producer, greet each talent guest and print scripts for script read through. Researched and secured props, talents, and locations needed for shoots for convenience and safety.

positions.title: Certified Community Producer
positions.description: Ten week training program based on field production.

positions.title: Production Intern
positions.description: Responsible for transcribing tapes, editing tapes, transporting props rental businesses and conducted research for show development.

positions.title: Production Intern
positions.description: Camera operator in field production, produced and edited videos on Final Cut software.

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description: Worked closely with the producer, director, and the Pru Production team, coordinated and communicated production resources and facility arrangements with the production managers. Cued pre­recorded material for business and financial customers. Attended and planned production meetings and produced timing schedules, shot lists and logs for post production.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered for those affected from Hurricane Sandy. Assisted loading goods onto cargos, traveling and delivering meals.
Patrolling traffic for bicyclists and preventing riders from getting injured.
